brief.note: Webull joins after a House panel flagged its China ties; the others' prices are last confirmed closes.

candidates.name: Webull Corporation
candidates.business: Runs a commission-free share and options trading app for retail investors
candidates.cause: A bipartisan House committee called the broker tied in structural ways to China's government, noting a mainland subsidiary employs about 62% of staff; Webull disputes the findings.
candidates.right: Washington takes no action and the China findings prove political noise rather than a business restriction
candidates.wrong: Regulators force a restructuring, or US brokers and partners quietly step away from Webull

candidates.name: C.H. Robinson Worldwide, Inc.
candidates.business: Arranges truck freight for shippers as North America's largest freight broker
candidates.cause: Agreed to buy rival broker RXO for $5.8bn in cash and stock, and investors balked at the debt, integration and antitrust risk despite $300m of promised synergies.
candidates.right: The $300m of synergies arrives on schedule and the combined broker gains pricing power
candidates.wrong: Integration drags, leverage bites and a soft freight market delays the promised earnings boost

candidates.name: Western Digital Corporation
candidates.business: Makes hard drives and flash storage for data centres and computers
candidates.cause: Toshiba said it will spend about $400m to double hard drive output by fiscal 2027, threatening the tight supply that drove storage shares up all year.
candidates.right: AI data centre demand absorbs the extra drives and prices hold through 2027
candidates.wrong: Supply catches up with demand and the pricing cycle turns before the capacity arrives

candidates.name: Seagate Technology Holdings plc
candidates.business: Makes hard drives for cloud and AI data centre storage
candidates.cause: Toshiba said it will spend about $400m to double hard drive output by fiscal 2027, threatening the tight supply that drove storage shares up all year.
candidates.right: Cloud customers keep signing long contracts and drive prices stay firm into 2027
candidates.wrong: The run unwinds as new capacity arrives and pricing power quietly fades
